Sec. closed with a word of praise for our internationals during the year, Middleton, Thresher, Bicourt, Geoff North, Boosey and Lerwill as well as the promising juniors without whom the club would have no future.

Mann, O'COnnor and Piotrowski are all going better than ever while Bicourt has been showing excellent early form. Bill Dance is keeping in fine trim up in Huddersfield, and Major and O'Hara are also running into form again.

With the "National" won - Fairclough 273; Major 302; and Bicourt 392 will complete the first team for the "Nine Cup". Ted Stimpson comments, "If they only trained from the Hall, they would have had six in six".

With Bicourt and Hart already in fine fettle we could well be having a celebration dip in the Lido on September 12th. With our Surrey men nicely tuned up after Woking they will be joined by our other big guns, Mann, O'Hara and O'Connor for the Blackheath Relay seven days later.
